createterraform.tooltip.terraform_extrud: Nothing but sky at this depth
createterraform.ponder.terraform_extrude: Printing terrain with a Terraform Extruder
The Terraform Extruder runs on rotation and a fluid called Mineral Substrate
It places a block two spaces in front of itself, at the same rate a Deployer works
What it places is whatever your world's own terrain generation would have put there. Ore turns up at its usual rarity and depth, caves come out cave-shaped, and ore from other mods needs no setup
Standing still it will only place into empty space — never over rock, not even its own. So it fills the spot once and then waits
Point a harvester at it and the harvester sets the pace
Depth is not displaced, only the horizontal, so the machine works best underground. Up here it mostly samples open sky, and says so under goggles
createterraform.ponder.extruder_contrapt: Glue an Extruder to a Rope Pulley, a Gantry Carriage or a Minecart Contraption and it prints as it travels
On the move it prints over whatever is already there, rather than only into empty space — which is the whole job, since displaced strata have to go somewhere
It runs off the contraption's own tanks, and several Extruders on one contraption share a seed, so a wide print comes out as one piece of rock rather than in patches
Driving back over ground it has already printed rerolls the offset, so the same vein cannot be farmed twice
